paragraphs: I HAVE READ AND UNDERSTAND ALL OF THE ITEMS ON THIS SYLLABUS INCLUDING:
_____ Plagiarism, Copying, Undeclared Multiple Submission, and Unauthorized Use of AI Tools

I certify that as a student at the Chinese University of Hong Kong (Shenzhen), I will not engage in any act of academic dishonesty including cheating or plagiarizing on any exam or assignment. I will not allow others to copy my work. I will not submit the same work (or any part thereof) to more than one class (undeclared multiple submission) without obtaining prior written permission from both instructors. I understand that every incident of cheating, plagiarizing, copying work, or undeclared multiple submission will be reported, and that there are severe punishments for these behaviors up to and including expulsion from the university.
